title: PM Takaichi Arrives in India for 16th India–Japan Annual Summit
detail: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived in New Delhi on July 1, 2026 for her first official visit to India, kicking off the 16th India-Japan Annual Summit (July 1-3) with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Takaichi was accompanied by a roughly 50-strong business delegation including Suzuki Motor president Toshihiro Suzuki and senior Itochu and Toyota Tsusho executives. Talks centered on the India-Japan Special Strategic and Global Partnership, energy resilience cooperation, defense ties, supply-chain resilience, and collaboration on AI and semiconductors.

sources.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
